products.name: EDF Tracker
products.problem: India's FEMA 2026 regulations (effective 1 Oct 2026) require every service exporter, including freelancers, to file a monthly EDF within 30 days of month-end and realise payment within 9 months; no threshold, bank SOPs unclear.
products.target_user: Indian freelancers, consultants, small agencies and software exporters invoicing foreign clients
products.social_promotion: drafted, not published (no social accounts connected)
